svg.aria-label: Gaussian Wasserstein gradient flows in the (m, sigma) half-plane: KL, squared W2, Fisher information
svg.text: orange-red: starting Gaussians 𝒩(m, σ²); green: trajectories; purple dots: positions at t = 0.5 and t = 1; blue: the target 𝒩(0,1)
only the W₂² flow moves on straight lines: the half-plane is flat for W₂ (W₂² = Δm² + Δσ²), and W₂² is the squared distance
